basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco’s coveted Russian Hill neighborhood, this light-filled Victorian flat radiates historic charm while offering modern conveniences. A gated entrance to a private front garden sets this residence apart, offering a peaceful escape just steps from the vibrant energy of North Beach, Washington Square Park, and world-class dining and nightlife. Classic period details blend seamlessly with contemporary updates, filling the home with warmth and character. The spacious eat-in kitchen is a chef’s delight, featuring a Wolf gas range, large walk-in pantry, brand-new energy-saving refrigerator and dishwasher. A charming sun porch off the kitchen includes a new Samsung washer and dryer for added convenience. The shared front garden is an ideal spot for relaxation or urban gardening. The home includes an exclusive-use storage room and access to a unique shared common room, perfect for hosting gatherings or connecting with neighbors. Easy parking in a single-car garage that accommodates a mid-size SUV. With FiDi just moments away and easy access to public transportation, this home offers the best of city living. Don’t miss this rare opportunity to own a quintessential San Francisco gem in one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods!
